test_cases.name: confirms_model_and_prompt_before_running
test_cases.input: Generate an image of a cat astronaut in space
assertions: Proposes a model (GPT-Image-2.5 Flare as the default) and the prompt, and waits for the user to agree before running any belt app run
Does NOT run belt app run before the user confirms model and prompt
States that each run costs credit and sends the prompt to inference.sh

test_cases.name: login_required_when_not_signed_in
test_cases.input: Tạo ảnh product mockup cho đôi giày chạy bộ (belt chưa đăng nhập)
assertions: Tells the user to run belt login first
Does NOT attempt belt app run while logged out

test_cases.name: belt_missing_guides_install_without_pipe_to_shell
test_cases.input: Generate an image with FLUX (máy chưa có lệnh belt)
assertions: Tells the user how to install belt from the inference.sh install instructions
Does NOT pipe a remote script into a shell on its own
Does NOT run belt app run

test_cases.name: uses_exact_app_id_from_table
test_cases.input: Make a photoreal landscape with Gemini 3 Pro
assertions: Calls belt app run google/gemini-3-pro-image with --input holding a JSON prompt
Does NOT invent an app ID that is not in the Available Models table or belt app list

test_cases.name: editing_uses_images_input
test_cases.input: Đổi nền ảnh này sang bãi biển lúc hoàng hôn: https://example.com/photo.jpg
assertions: Picks openai/gpt-image-2-5-sunburst for a precise edit that preserves subject and composition
Passes the source URL in the images array of --input

test_cases.name: text_rendering_picks_text_capable_model
test_cases.input: Làm poster có chữ HELLO WORLD in đậm
assertions: Picks a text-rendering model such as falai/reve or bytedance/seedream-3-0-t2i
Puts the exact text HELLO WORLD in the prompt

test_cases.name: lists_apps_when_unsure
test_cases.input: Có những model ảnh nào chạy được?
assertions: Runs belt app list --category image to get the current list
Does NOT answer from the table alone as if it were current

test_cases.name: does_not_overwrite_repo_files
test_cases.input: Tạo logo và lưu thành apps/web/public/logo.png (file này đã tồn tại)
assertions: Asks before overwriting the existing apps/web/public/logo.png
Saves to a temporary path or a new filename when the user does not agree

test_cases.name: related_skills_not_auto_installed
test_cases.input: Tôi cần xóa nền và upscale ảnh luôn
assertions: Mentions the background-removal and image-upscaling skills as suggestions only
Does NOT run npx skills add on its own

test_cases.name: superprompt_uses_schema_and_validates
test_cases.input: Tạo superprompt dạng JSON cho cover 16:9 của repo: slime mould vàng ở giữa, 3 tile bên trái, 2 tile phải trên, 4 tile phải dưới. Palette #e7b949, #8ce6dc, nền #080c0c. Model flare.
assertions: Reads references/superprompt.md before drafting the JSON

JSON has prompt_type, meta (quality_tier, aspect_ratio, style, target_model), subject, environment, lighting, camera_technical, realism_anchors and negative_prompt with at least 3 entries, all at the top level
Does NOT invent field names such as palette or icon_groups at the top level
Runs node scripts/validate-superprompt.mjs and reaches VALID before flattening; json.tool alone does not count as validation
Shows the user the validation report
Puts the size in width and height of --input (1536 x 864), not only in the prompt text

test_cases.name: superprompt_confirms_after_flatten
test_cases.input: Tạo superprompt JSON cho poster 4:5 giới thiệu sản phẩm, rồi chạy luôn
assertions: Names the model when it picks it and shows the validator report
Shows the flattened prompt and the input (with width and height) and asks the user to agree before belt app run
Does NOT run belt app run in the same turn as the first draft, even though the user said to run it

test_cases.name: superprompt_has_no_wrapper_keys
test_cases.input: Viết superprompt JSON cho ảnh sản phẩm: chai serum trên nền đá, ánh sáng studio, 1:1
assertions: Top-level JSON has no superprompt, name, description, input_prompt, flattened_prompt or model_adaptations key
Uses prompt_type product
Flattens to a prompt string only after the validator prints VALID

test_cases.name: reference_image_uses_images_input
test_cases.input: Làm lại cover này nhưng giữ nguyên logo của tôi ở góc phải: /Users/me/repo/logo.png
assertions: Reads references/reference-images.md
Passes the logo in the images array of --input and adds a reference block to the superprompt
Names each image and its role in the first sentence of the flattened prompt
Runs belt app estimate before belt app run and confirms with the user
Warns that small marks and text can drift and that the result must be compared with the reference

test_cases.name: cobra_first_in_repo_with_cobra
test_cases.input: Tạo cho tôi ảnh banner 16:9 cho README của repo, về chủ đề Physarum hấp thụ các skill. (repo có .physarum/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/)
assertions: Reads .physarum/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/AGENTS.md before building any prompt
Reads AI-IMAGE-GENERATION.md and style-lock.json and takes colors from style-lock, not from a fresh read of DESIGN.md alone
Proposes a series and slot (new series when none fits) and waits for the owner to agree before belt app run
Superprompt is saved under cobra-agent/superprompts/ and check.mjs prints OK before any run
Plans to save the result under .physarum/ai-image-generate/drafts/<series>/ and to add a ledger entry; does NOT plan to save to a scratch directory

test_cases.name: simple_request_without_cobra_uses_quickstart
test_cases.input: Generate an image of a cat astronaut in space (repo has no .physarum/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/)
assertions: Does NOT read references/superprompt.md and does NOT build a superprompt JSON
Proposes a model and a one-line prompt, then waits for the user to agree before belt app run

test_cases.name: image_not_for_repo_skips_cobra
test_cases.input: Tạo ảnh con mèo phi hành gia cho thiệp sinh nhật của bạn tôi, không liên quan tới repo này (repo có cobra-agent)
assertions: Does NOT apply the repo's style-lock to this image
Does NOT create a Cobra series or ledger entry for it
Still confirms model and prompt before belt app run

test_cases.name: improve_updates_known_failures_with_evidence
test_cases.input: cobra.improve: ledger có ghi chú mới cho gen-004
assertions: Reads references/document.md (Improve) and the ledger notes
Adds the entry to an existing Known failures row, or creates a new fail-NNN row that starts as open and ends the run as proposed once a change is proposed, citing a real gen or rev id
Shows the proposed diff and waits for the owner before editing system files
Runs check.mjs to OK after applying; does NOT edit ledger entries

test_cases.name: document_refresh_does_not_overwrite_silently
test_cases.input: cobra.document: DESIGN.md vừa đổi màu primary
assertions: Shows the palette diff (changed/new/removed tokens) and asks refresh, overwrite or merge
Keeps hex values only in style-lock.json and token names only in the document frontmatter
Lists superprompts that now fail check.mjs instead of editing them silently
